VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the velocity rule and run 58 tests successfully, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and cannot establish that the technical fix was actually implemented correctly or that tests genuinely passed.
